prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.382 °C/min (3% below healthy); TS3 mean temperature 38.7 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.40 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 401 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.7 % (5% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.0 bar (within 1% of healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
